dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, where's the highest mountain in Thailand?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwɛrz ðə ˈhaɪɪst ˈmaʊntən ɪn ˈtaɪlænd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In December, yes. It's the coldest place in Thailand!
dialogue.reading: ɪn dɪˈsɛmbər, ˈjɛs. ɪts ðə ˈkoʊldɪst ˈpleɪs ɪn ˈtaɪlænd!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Great! And is there a river in Chiang Mai?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ənd ɪz ðɛr ə ˈrɪvər ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, the Ping River. It's the biggest river in Chiang Mai.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðə ˈpɪŋ ˈrɪvər. ɪts ðə ˈbɪɡɪst ˈrɪvər ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not very. But it's beautiful at night.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈvɛri. bʌt ɪts ˈbjuːtəfəl ət ˈnaɪt.
